title: Register an Australian Business Number (ABN)
summary: This page provides information on how to register for a unique 11-digit Australian Business Number (ABN) for your business.
intro:
An ABN is a unique 11 digit number that identifies your business to the public, the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other government agencies.

The form will also:

Select the ‘Register now’ button to register an ABN.
